text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A above my average cost felt rewarding, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should consider the position’s role in my portfolio.","My account value fell overall despite a profitable sale, reminding me that one realized gain does not protect the whole portfolio from losses.","Recent price movements are random and do not predict what comes next, so I should avoid reacting to short-term changes and make decisions based on risk and diversification."]}
